### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 - 1024, 45):** Contains app icon/title (left), utility icons (center-right), and window controls (far right).
*   **Sidebar (Left Pane) (0, 46 - 280, 944):** Navigation rail. Width ~280px. Background is light blue.
    *   **Section: Data Recovery (10, 80 - 270, 260):** Contains "Hardware Disk" (selected), "SD Card", and "More Recovery Tools".
    *   **Section: Advanced Features (10, 370 - 270, 520):** Contains "File Repair" and "Lost Partition Rescue".
    *   **Section: File Backup (10, 560 - 270, 650):** Contains "ChronoSnap Backup".
*   **Main Content Area (281, 46 - 1024, 944):** White background.
    *   **Header (310, 110 - 700, 150):** "Select a location to search for lost data".
    *   **Internal Drives Section (310, 190 - 600, 370):** Label + Card Grid.
        *   **Card 1 (Windows(C:)) (312, 235 - 575, 365):** Selected state with blue border and checkmark.
        *   **Card 2 (Partially visible):** To the right of Card 1.
    *   **Specify a Location Section (310, 400 - 750, 690):** Label + Icon-Text Grid (2 columns).
        *   **Item 1: Recycle Bin (330, 460 - 480, 540).**
        *   **Item 2: Desktop (610, 470 - 730, 530).**
        *   **Item 3: Select Folder (330, 610 - 480, 680).**
    *   **Footer Bar (281, 840 - 1024, 944):** Fixed at bottom of content area.
        *   **Left:** Info text "Unable to find your hard drive?" + Help icon.
        *   **Right:** Primary CTA Button "Search for Lost Data".
*   **AI Assistant Popover (Overlay) (640, 65 - 895, 390):** Floating card in top-right quadrant.
*   **Windows Taskbar (0, 945 - 1024, 1000):** System taskbar at bottom.

### 2. TEXT
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar Header:** `Data Recovery`
*   **Sidebar Item 1:** `Hardware Disk`
*   **Sidebar Item 2:** `SD Card`
*   **Sidebar Item 3:** `More Recovery Tools`
*   **Sidebar Header 2:** `Advanced Features`
*   **Sidebar Item 4:** `File Repair`
*   **Sidebar Item 5:** `Lost Partition Rescue`
*   **Sidebar Header 3:** `File Backup`
*   **Sidebar Item 6:** `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Heading:** `Select a location to search for lost data` (Note: Truncated by AI popover on right edge)
*   **Subheading 1:** `Internal drives (2)`
*   **Card 1 Title:** `Windows(C:)`
*   **Card 1 Stats:** `31.15 GB/149.45 GB`
*   **Subheading 2:** `Specify a location`
*   **Location Item 1:** `Recycle Bin`
*   **Location Item 2:** `Desktop`

*   **AI List Item 4:** `Chat with us`
*   **System Tray Time:** `6:13 PM`
*   **System Tray Date:** `10/17/2026`

### 3. COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/Main Area: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Sidebar: `#EAF2FF` (Light Periwinkle Blue) - ESTIMATED
    *   Sidebar Selection: `#D6E4FF` (Slightly darker blue) - ESTIMATED
    *   AI Popover BG: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   AI Popover Header BG: `#F5F5FA` (Very Light Lavender/Gray) - ESTIMATED
    *   Taskbar: `#F3F3F3` (Light Gray) - ESTIMATED
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Headings/Names): `#1F1F1F` (Near Black) - ESTIMATED
    *   Secondary Text (Stats/Subheadings): `#666666` or `#555555` (Dark Gray) - ESTIMATED
    *   Sidebar Text (Selected): `#000000` or very dark blue - ESTIMATED
    *   Sidebar Text (Normal): `#333333` - ESTIMATED
*   **Accents & Borders:**
    *   Primary Blue (Button/Selection/Icons): `#2D7FF9` (Vibrant Blue) - ESTIMATED
    *   Progress Bar Fill: `#2D7FF9` - ESTIMATED
    *   Progress Bar Track: `#E0E0E0` - ESTIMATED
    *   Card Border (Selected): `#2D7FF9`, 2px stroke - ESTIMATED
    *   Card Border (Normal): `#E0E0E0` or `#Dcdcdc`, 1px stroke - ESTIMATED
    *   Success Checkmark (Sidebar): `#28A745` (Green) - ESTIMATED

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Main Heading:** ~20-22px, Semi-bold (600).
*   **Subheadings (Internal drives, Specify...):** ~14px, Regular (400), Dark Gray.
*   **Card Titles (Windows(C:), etc.):** ~15-16px, Medium (500).
*   **Card Stats (31.15 GB...):** ~12px, Regular (400), Gray.
*   **Sidebar Items:** ~14px, Regular (400).
*   **Sidebar Section Headers:** ~12px, Regular (400), Lighter Gray.
*   **Button Text:** ~14-15px, Medium/Semi-bold (500/600), White.
*   **AI Assistant Text:** ~13-14px, Regular.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~280px.
*   **Card Size (Selected):** Width ~265px, Height ~130px.
*   **Card Padding:** ~16px internal padding.
*   **Card Border Radius:** ~8px.
*   **Icon Size (Sidebar):** 24x24px.
*   **Icon Size (Cards/Locations):** 48x48px or 64x64px (Large thumbnails).
*   **Button Height:** ~44px.
*   **Button Padding (Horizontal):** ~24px.
*   **Button Border Radius:** ~6px or 8px.
*   **Gutter (Grid):** ~24px between cards/location items.
*   **AI Popover Shadow:** Large soft shadow (Y-offset ~10px, Blur ~20px).

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar List Item (Hardware Disk):** State = **Selected**. Indicated by background color change (`#D6E4FF`) and green checkmark badge on the right.
*   **Device Tile (Windows(C:)):** State = **Selected/Focused**. Indicated by blue border (`#2D7FF9`), blue checkmark circle icon (top-right inside), and blue progress bar highlight.
*   **Device Tile (Partially visible neighbor):** State = **Normal**. Light gray border.
*   **Location Icons (Recycle Bin, etc.):** State = **Normal**. No visible selection border here, implying they are unselected.
*   **Primary Button ("Search for Lost Data"):** State = **Normal/Enabled**. Solid blue background, white text.
*   **Window Controls:** Minimize, Maximize, Close (Top Right).
*   **AI Assistant Popover:** State = **Open/Visible**. Overlaying main content.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, filled (mostly), with slight gradients or solid colors. "Fluent Design" or modern Windows style.
*   **Sidebar Icons:**
    *   Hardware Disk: Blue grid/window shape.
    *   SD Card: Gray SD card shape.
    *   More Recovery Tools: Gray tools/wrench shape.
    *   File Repair: Gray folder with tool.
    *   Lost Partition Rescue: Gray circle/arrows (refresh/rescue).
    *   ChronoSnap Backup: Gray circular arrow (backup).
*   **Main Area Icons:**
    *   Windows(C:): Large Windows logo + Hard Drive graphic.
    *   Recycle Bin: Gray bin with 'C' arrow.
    *   Desktop: Monitor screen shape.
    *   Select Folder: Folder shape.
*   **Header Icons (Top Right):**
    *   Wizard/AI character (Blue hat).
    *   Cart/Basket (Orange).
    *   Target/Bullseye (Brown).
    *   Info (i).
    *   Menu (Hamburger).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Selection Ready**. The user is at the first step of the wizard (selecting a location). The default option "Hardware Disk" > "Windows(C:)" is pre-selected.
*   **Motion Cues:** None explicitly captured (static image), but the AI popover suggests an active "onboarding" or "assistant" mode. The "Unable to find your hard drive?" text in the footer suggests contextual help based on system state (perhaps no external drives detected).
